note: City of Wisner river park along the Elkhorn River (south side of town, 1111 Ave E). Concrete camper pads under the trees between the ball fields and the park's gravel river road, plus a row near the rodeo arena by the East Parking Lot; electric at some pads (the city page gives no count or amperage). Kids' fishing pond, boat dock on the Elkhorn. The park hosts the Wisner Lions Club Rodeo, a livestock show and the Thunder by the River truck and tractor pull. --Claude
summary: City of Wisner pages (dated 2024-09-11) found: $20/night (stored note said $15), all sites first come first serve, 14-day limit, 28 camper pads, showers; booking/fees/sites/facilities now manual. Website should move off VisitNebraska to the city page. Pads sit ~35-50 m from the Elkhorn across the park's gravel river road; not waterfront stands. Pin is among the pads.
